Fit conditional extremes dependence model

Source: R/dep.R
cecl_dep.Rd

Fit the conditional extremes dependence model of Heffernan and Tawn (2004) to data transformed to Laplace scale.

cecl_dep(
  obj,
  cond_prob,
  vars = NULL,
  cond_var = NULL,
  start = c(a = 0.01, b = 0.01),
  ncores = 1,
  nruns = 1,
  aLow = -1,
  fixed_b = FALSE,
  fit_no_keef = FALSE
)

Arguments

obj

Object of class cecl_marg containing transformed data.

cond_prob

Numeric vector of quantiles to use for conditioning variables.

vars

Character vector of variable names to fit dependence model for. If NULL, all variables are used.

cond_var

Character vector of variable names to condition on. If NULL, all variables are used.

start

Named numeric vector or list of named numeric matrices with starting values for dependence parameters a and b. If a list, must have one entry per location.

ncores

Number of cores to use for parallel processing.

nruns

Number of optimization runs with different starting values.

aLow

Lower bound for dependence parameter a.

fixed_b

Logical indicating whether to fix dependence parameter b at start value.

fit_no_keef

Logical indicating whether to fit the model without Keef et al. (2012) constraints.

Value

Object of class cecl_dep containing fitted dependence parameters and residuals.
